  "description": "Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores is a proudly Nigerian, multi-service retail brand committed to meeting the everyday needs of our customers through quality products, excellent service, and community-focused operations. We operate a unique combination of businesses under one roof, making us a convenient and trusted destination for families and individuals alike.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head of Inventory
Job Location: Plot 1225 Oladipo Diya Street, Gudu, Abuja(FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Oversee inventory management and stock control across all branches and warehouses.
	Develop and implement effective inventory control policies, procedures, and systems.
	Monitor stock movements, stock levels, replenishment, and inventory accuracy.
	Coordinate periodic stock counts, reconciliations, and inventory audits.
	Investigate stock discrepancies, shrinkage, damages, expiries, and unexplained losses.
	Analyse inventory data and provide actionable reports to Management.
	Ensure proper inventory documentation and compliance with established procedures.
	Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Audit, Warehouse, and Branch Operations teams.
	Identify opportunities to optimize stockholding costs and improve inventory turnover.
	Supervise and evaluate inventory personnel across the organisation.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Logistics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in inventory management, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
	Must have substantial inventory management experience in a reputable retail organisation, supermarket chain, or FMCG retail environment.
	Strong knowledge of inventory control systems, ERP software, and stock reconciliation.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and inventory data analysis.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
	Proven experience managing inventory across multiple branches or locations.
	High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

Head of Inventory Job at Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores




        
    

        
        Bakangizo Pharmacy and Stores is a proudly Nigerian, multi-service retail brand committed to meeting the everyday needs of our customers through quality products, excellent service, and community-focused operations. We operate a unique combination of businesses under one roof, making us a convenient and trusted destination for families and individuals alike.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Head of Inventory
Job Location: Plot 1225 Oladipo Diya Street, Gudu, Abuja(FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Oversee inventory management and stock control across all branches and warehouses.
	Develop and implement effective inventory control policies, procedures, and systems.
	Monitor stock movements, stock levels, replenishment, and inventory accuracy.
	Coordinate periodic stock counts, reconciliations, and inventory audits.
	Investigate stock discrepancies, shrinkage, damages, expiries, and unexplained losses.
	Analyse inventory data and provide actionable reports to Management.
	Ensure proper inventory documentation and compliance with established procedures.
	Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Audit, Warehouse, and Branch Operations teams.
	Identify opportunities to optimize stockholding costs and improve inventory turnover.
	Supervise and evaluate inventory personnel across the organisation.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Logistics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in inventory management, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
	Must have substantial inventory management experience in a reputable retail organisation, supermarket chain, or FMCG retail environment.
	Strong knowledge of inventory control systems, ERP software, and stock reconciliation.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and inventory data analysis.
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
	Proven experience managing inventory across multiple branches or locations.
	High level of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

  "title": "Project Manager",
  "description": "Dwellion Design was founded in 2017, we have been motivated by a desire to better serve our clients and work closely with our clients to create personalized, stress-free design experiences, helping families and businesses express themselves through their unique spaces Dwellion Design delivers strategic interior design planning and environmental branding to transform hotels, restaurants, luxury multi-family properties, retail, commercial spaces, and more. We always begin with you, your interests, and your requirements.Then we consider the ideal project to bring your ideal new house to life.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Manager
Job Location: Chevron-Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities


	Prepare and review structural designs and calculations for buildings and civil works.
	Interpret architectural drawings and convert them into structural engineering designs.
	Develop structural drawings for foundations, beams, slabs, columns, and reinforcement detailing.
	Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) based on architectural and engineering drawings.
	Support procurement by preparing material specifications and quantity requirements.
	Review supplier and subcontractor quotations against BOQ specifications.
	Track project expenditures and provide cost performance reports.
